name: sol8-evidence-search-fit
goal: Keep the entire evidence search placeholder visible at desktop, tablet and mobile without changing its accessible label.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: API baseline 588388c4b5fc9673d2fe8bf2bdb0170f437a3d4d417c1f3d70913fd3a883003a at 6bd7a6150f shows the mobile placeholder clipped, while desktop and tablet fit.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing gallery matrix covered filled search and open status filters but did not compare the empty placeholder text width with the input content width. Add that assertion after its canonical capture.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record 13290593f233e5ea99e89c0e990329150f84272265a1e5c470da420452871051 at 4e84451e99: mobile measures 305.04 pixels in 300 available; desktop/tablet pass.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Committed 0879fc8cc2: the visible search placeholder uses concise localized text; the complete accessible label remains.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged frozen browser command passed all three viewports at 0879fc8cc2; record 9d12d02f763f090d582d2dc2dabb34df97f661ec534a7dd944d5c726213db5bb.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
